problem.title: Why screen control without smart pauses doesn't work

0.title: Irritability and meltdowns
0.text: Abrupt switching from screen to reality causes stress, tantrums, and aggression in children.

1.title: Concentration problems
1.text: A constant stream of fast information weakens the ability to focus on homework, reading, and play.

2.title: Apathy and low mood
2.text: The virtual world feels brighter while real life seems duller, reducing motivation and interest.

3.title: Health issues
3.text: Risks to eyesight (dryness, deterioration) and excess weight from sedentary habits and poor nutrition.

problem.heading: Irritability and meltdowns
problem.intro: When screen time ends abruptly, a child's brain can't switch from bright, dynamic content to calm reality. The result is outbursts of anger, tears, and the feeling that devices control the whole family's mood. With smart pauses, we help children notice their reactions, make micro-transitions, and gradually leave the screen without conflict.
